map.算例：数学8/10(1.5h)·英语12/20(1h)·物理5/8(2h)，日投: Example: Math 8/10 (1.5h) · English 12/20 (1h) · Physics 5/8 (2h), daily input 4h, target 2026-10-01
map.剩余学时 = (10−8)×1.5 + (20−12)×1.0 + (8−5)×: Remaining hours = (10−8)×1.5 + (20−12)×1.0 + (8−5)×2.0 = 3+8+6 = 17 h; total progress = (8+12+5)/(10+20+8) = 25/38 ≈ 65.8%; days needed = ceil(17/4) = 5 days → expected completion 2026-09-15; 21 days to target 2026-10-01, 5 ≤ 21 → on track.
map.预计完成日为什么有时比预期早很多？: Why is the expected completion date sometimes much earlier than expected?
map.完成日 = 今天 + 剩余学时÷每日投入小时，向上取整到整天；若剩余学时少或日投: Completion date = today + remaining hours ÷ daily input hours, rounded up to whole days; fewer remaining hours or higher daily input naturally brings it earlier. Note it assumes the ideal of “stable daily input”; actual leave/interruption delays it, so keep a buffer.
map.单任务耗时怎么估计更准？: How can I estimate hours per task more accurately?
map.用「该科目近期真实完成若干任务的平均耗时」作 hours，比拍脑袋准；完成后再回: Use the average time of several recently completed tasks in that subject as hours — more accurate than guessing; after finishing, backfill the actual value and the tool gets closer to the real pace as data accumulates. Progress counts by task number regardless of difficulty; split heavy tasks for a smoother curve.
